text:
Maya (Design): quick ping — spiking a design nits thread for the trace inspector UX, mostly export copy + accessibility bits.
Sam R (Eng runtime): thanks, link to the current mock? :eyes:
Maya (Design): https://figma.com/.../trace-inspector v3 — main questions are export labeling, stack trace folding defaults, and timestamp contrast in timeline.
Jon (Frontend): saw it. main thing: 'Download' feels ambiguous. Users expect filetype. proposal: 'Export trace (JSON / HAR)'.
Ava (SRE): +1 for explicit filetypes. We also need a server-side endpoint that preserves correlation IDs for exported traces — saw some missing fields when exporting for incidents.
Sam R (Eng runtime): noted. current export payload omits 'parent_trace_id' for descendants unless you toggle "Include linked requests". That's probably why.
Maya (Design): UI copy quibble: the checkbox text currently reads "Include related requests" — suggestion: "Include linked requests (adds parent/child traces)" — clearer for on-call folks.
Leo (Product): agree — make it explicit what "related" means. Also can we surface expected file size estimate before export? For big traces that blocks download, team asks for warning.
Jon (Frontend): we can compute rough size from event count client-side and show "~2.4MB". low effort.
Ava (SRE): Accessibility nit: timeline timestamp contrast is 3.8:1 on some theme combos. Need >=4.5:1 for small text. Also keyboard focus on trace nodes is awkward — focus ring jumps order.
Sam R (Eng runtime): thanks — we should add a11y ticket. I can reproduce the focus order bug; looks like the node list is built with a virtualized list that changes DOM order. We'll fix tabindex management.
Maya (Design): also stack traces: default collapse depth is currently 5. For most users it's noisy. Suggest default collapsed with a single "Expand all frames" CTA near the top.
Jon (Frontend): prefer small affordance: show top 3 frames and a "Show 12 more" inline link. Keeps vertical rhythm.
Leo (Product): decision time: compact default (top 3) and persistent user preference. We have customers who rely on full frames by default for debugging though.
Ava (SRE): can be a per-org setting behind a feature flag. For oncall, default compact is nicer.
Sam R (Eng runtime): technical note: rendering thousands of frames breaks prefix-caching perf. Compact default also helps throughput.
Maya (Design): final copy ask: change export CTA from "Download" to "Export trace" and in the modal include two radio options: "JSON (for ingestion)" and "HAR (for network replay)" with 1-line descriptions.
Jon (Frontend): I'll mock those radios and add aria-describedby linking to the help text. Will also include an aria-live region for export progress.
Leo (Product): can we add a small tooltip on correlation IDs: "Correlation ID ties requests across services — click to copy" — people often don't know what to do with it.
Ava (SRE): +1, and copy-to-clipboard should show a transient toast with copy confirmation and an invite to create a share link if available.
Maya (Design): styling note: please increase the token color contrast used for correlation ID chips. Currently it's low on dark theme.
Sam R (Eng runtime): logged infra task to keep correlation id in export payload and ensure copy behavior. I'll add tests.
Jon (Frontend): will add keyboard shortcut support for expand/collapse frames (press 'f' for frames toggle) — document in UX notes.
Maya (Design): thanks all — action items: Jon: mock radios + accessible export modal; Sam: include correlation IDs in export + tabindex fix; Ava: confirm default compact for oncall flows; Leo: finalize wording for modal and tooltip.
DeployBot: deployment scheduled for canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC — will include frontend changes only if PR merged before 22:00 UTC tonight.
Leo (Product): ok team, will coordinate wording PR. Thanks! :party:
